programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u057/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker = 7 if any(7 in row for row in grid) else 1
    line = 3
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]
        for left, right in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                out[r][c] = line
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        for top, bottom in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                out[r][c] = line
    return out
'''
